import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();

        // Replace all "dot" with '.' (except first and last character)
        while (true) {
            String inner;
            if (s.length() >= 2) {
                inner = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
            } else {
                inner = "";
            }
            int a = inner.indexOf("dot");
            if (a == -1) {
                break;
            }
            // a is index in inner, so in s the "dot" starts at a+1
            s = s.substring(0, a + 1) + '.' + s.substring(a + 4);
        }

        // Replace first "at" with '@' (once, even if not found)
        String inner;
        if (s.length() >= 2) {
            inner = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        } else {
            inner = "";
        }
        int a = inner.indexOf("at");
        // For the replacement, mimic Python's slicing behavior even when a == -1
        String part1 = s.substring(0, a + 1); // when a==-1, a+1=0 -> safe
        String part2;
        if (a + 3 < s.length()) {
            part2 = s.substring(a + 3);
        } else {
            part2 = "";
        }
        s = part1 + '@' + part2;

        System.out.println(s);
    }
}
